title: Reverse the dial
body: I love the thought of this app, but in reality I struggle to use it. I am used to timers where the dial is set clockwise and counts down counter clockwise winding back to zero or twelve, and my brain will not accept and understand the concept of keeping track when it’s the other way around like here. Perhaps the option exists already and I simply cannot find it?! Or else I hope that I might not be the only one having this difficulty and that the option will come at some point.

title: What a joke!
body:
Not the most complicated app.
And then again.. crashes!

When you return, the watch is RESET.
OR crashes.
A joke, and a waste of time and money!!
